english: Welcome to ForamEcoQS. This tutorial goes from an abundance matrix to ecological indices and a clear plot.
Open the CSV. Rows are species, columns are samples, and cells are integer counts.
Select the appropriate databank, compare species names, and review unmatched taxa.
Review calculation settings, then select the indices required for the analysis.
For TSI, enter mud percentage separately for each sample.
Inspect numerical results and ecological quality classes.
Select only Foram-AMBI, FSI, and exp(H'bc) for a readable line plot.
Use Composite Panel for a compact overview.
Keep plots focused, export results, and document every setting.
